Full job description
Oracle HCM Solution Architect

We are seeking an experienced Oracle HCM Solution Architect to support a large-scale HCM technology environment. This individual will be responsible for designing and overseeing integrations between Oracle HCM, legacy systems, SaaS applications, payroll platforms, and third-party providers. The ideal candidate combines strong HCM domain knowledge with deep technical architecture and integration experience.

Responsibilities

Serve as the lead Solution Architect for Oracle HCM initiatives

Design integrations between Oracle HCM and enterprise applications/platforms

Architect solutions that enable multiple HR, payroll, SaaS, and third-party systems to communicate effectively

Support the migration and integration of legacy HR/HCM data into Oracle HCM

Define APIs, interfaces, middleware, data flows, and integration patterns

Evaluate existing integrations and recommend modernization or consolidation opportunities

Partner with HR, IT, development teams, vendors, and implementation partners

Provide architectural leadership throughout design, implementation, testing, and deployment

Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards

Qualifications

10–15+ years of Solution Architecture experience

8+ years of HCM technology experience

Strong experience with Oracle HCM / Oracle Cloud HCM

Extensive HCM integration architecture experience

Experience integrating SaaS applications and third-party platforms

Experience with ADP or similar payroll/HR platforms

Strong experience with legacy system/data migration

Knowledge of APIs, middleware, interfaces, and enterprise integration patterns

Ability to work across both high-level architecture and detailed technical integration requirements

Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills

Preferred

Experience with complex, multi-platform enterprise HCM environments

Large-scale HCM transformation or modernization experience

Benefits-related HCM experience is a plus

Experience working with external implementation or technology providers

Ideal Background: Oracle HCM | Solution Architecture | HCM Integrations | SaaS | APIs | Middleware | Legacy Data Migration | ADP
